title: Cross-cluster node pool (Rhea + Hecate)
shape: infra: same k31ws environment and pool tooling on Rhea and Hecate (VR200, 4 GPUs/node)
gap_analysis: Hecate is back and reachable from the Mac only (Hecate login cannot reach Rhea: ssh times out), so every copy is relayed through the Mac. The image on Hecate already exists under another name (k3vr/images/k31vr-kmc_kmr-sweep-freeze...-r1): sha256 equal to Rhea's kimi-k31-wzhao-nov-11-aarch64.sqsh (d69ed067...), hard-linked to the same path on Hecate. Benches use dummy weights, so the model views need only configs/tokenizer (copied with their symlinks; Hecate's kimi-k3.1-pro-release-d9e99b07 has the identical config.json and is linked as models/kimi-k3.1-pro).
plan: Hecate k31ws tree: image, base-4fbaa15, models views, tools (done 19:45)
holdd-ws.sh cluster-aware (Hecate partitions/accounts, cserve batch 2 h cap, hold8 --segment=8 on one partition) + lock-aware keepalive for the Hecate idle reaper
Adopt the old pending Hecate r2 holds (rename) after neutralising runner2's keepalive2 for pool holds
mkov.sh stages to both clusters; mkov.sh --copy <tag> mirrors an existing overlay
wsrun.sh (Mac): same CLI as wsgpu.sh, -c rhea|hecate|auto, picks the earliest free slot, mirrors Hecate results back to Rhea
Validate: same NVFP4 decode slice on both clusters, agree within noise; directive line in ALL.md
